title: Geo request scoring for tiered failover and data-residency constraints
creator: Sofia Ramirez
description: Problem: Enterprise customers request region availability and explicit data residency guarantees or failover topologies. Current intake is ad-hoc, producing inconsistent prioritization and costly one-off engineering work. Goal: design a repeatable scoring heuristic and accompanying intake form that balances customer requirements (residency, RTO/RPO, latency), platform constraints (capacity, cost, regulatory risk), and commercial signals (ARR, contract stage). Deliver a triage playbook that can be used by Sales/CS/PM to classify requests into: Quick Add (low lift), Scheduled Onboarding (medium lift), Enterprise Program (high lift) and Failover Only (no data residency change).
acceptance_criteria: Standard intake form fields finalized and published in Confluence (customer legal, residency region, failover topology, data flows, compliance needs, desired SLAs)
Scoring heuristic defined that outputs a Tier (Quick Add / Scheduled Onboarding / Enterprise Program / Failover Only) and a numeric priority score
Automation prototype that computes score from intake payload (script or spreadsheet) and a short demo run against last 12 months of intake data
Triage runbook published and linked from intake form with explicit handoffs to Sales Ops, Solutions Eng, Legal, and Capacity Planning
Cost estimation template for each Tier with typical infra and implementation ranges
Integration design for Console entitlement flags to represent region entitlements and failover topology (design doc ready, not necessarily shipped)
Stakeholder review completed (Legal, Security, Solutions Eng, Infra) and signoff recorded in comments
